title: Molecularly guided therapy in gastrointestinal malignancies: From established targets to resistance and emerging precision strategies
abstractText: Gastrointestinal (GI) malignancies comprise a heterogeneous group of cancers in which molecular alterations increasingly guide therapeutic selection. Biomarker-driven therapies are established in selected colorectal, gastric and gastroesophageal junction, biliary, pancreatic, and GI stromal tumors. However, primary and acquired resistance, tumor heterogeneity, evolving molecular profiles, and unequal access to molecular diagnostics limit durable benefit. This narrative review evaluates the current landscape of molecularly targeted therapies across major GI malignancies, focusing on validated molecular targets, clinical evidence, biomarker selection, resistance mechanisms, and emerging therapeutic strategies. A structured literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar for publications from January 2000 to 30 July 2026. Evidence was narratively synthesized according to tumor type and molecular target and graded as A (randomized phase III evidence or established standard of care), B (prospective phase II or substantial clinical evidence), C (early-phase, retrospective, or limited clinical evidence), or D (preclinical or experimental evidence). Molecularly targeted therapy is now an established component of treatment for selected molecular subgroups. Key advances include genotype-directed therapy in colorectal cancer and cholangiocarcinoma, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2- and claudin 18.2-directed approaches in gastric cancer, KIT proto-oncogene receptor tyrosine kinase/platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha-directed treatment in GI stromal tumor, and molecularly selected strategies in pancreatic cancer. Resistance, intratumoral heterogeneity, molecular evolution, and inconsistent biomarker assessment remain major barriers. Emerging approaches include next-generation inhibitors, antibody–drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, cellular therapies, circulating tumor DNA-guided treatment, targeted–immunotherapy combinations, and tissue-agnostic strategies. Further progress will require accessible biomarker testing, longitudinal molecular assessment, rational treatment sequencing, and prospective evaluation of emerging precision therapies.

title: Pengaruh Store Atmosphere Dan Kualitas Pelayanan Terhadap Kepuasan Konsumen Hotway’s Chicken Plaju
abstractText: Penelitian ini menguji bagaimana atmosfer gerai (store atmosphere) dan kualitas pelayanan memengaruhi tingkat kepuasan konsumen Hotway's Chicken Plaju. Menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif deskriptif, data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner berskala Likert (1-5) yang disebarkan kepada 120 pelanggan. Sampel dipilih menggunakan teknik accidental sampling ynag merupakan bagian dari nonprobability sampling. Evaluasi data dilakukan via Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Square (SEM-PLS) berbantuan software SmartPLS 4. Temuan riset membuktikan bahwa atmosfer gerai dan kualitas pelayanan secara langsung memberikan dampak positif serta signifikan terhadap kepuasan konsumen. Di samping itu, atmosfer gerai juga memperkuat kualitas pelayanan, di mana variabel kualitas pelayanan terbukti sukses memediasi hubungan antara atmosfer gerai dengan kepuasan ynag dirasakan oleh pelanggan. This study examines how store atmosphere and service quality influence the satisfaction levels of Hotway's Chicken Plaju customers. Employing a descriptive quantitative approach, data were collected via a Likert-scale (1–5) questionnaire distributed to 120 customers. The sample was selected using accidental sampling, a type of non-probability sampling. Data analysis was conducted using Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) with the aid of SmartPLS 4 software. The research findings demonstrate that store atmosphere and service quality have a direct, positive, and significant impact on customer satisfaction. Furthermore, store atmosphere reinforces service quality, with the service quality variable successfully mediating the relationship between store atmosphere and customer-perceived satisfaction.

title: Sudden death due to acute variceal bleeding: A review of diagnostic challenges and clinical presentation
abstractText: Acute variceal bleeding is one of the most fatal complications in patients with pre-existing portal hypertension secondary to chronic liver disease. Fatality from this condition is potentially preventable but requires urgent medical attention. The diagnosis is often challenging because patients may present with diverse manifestations, ranging from vague epigastric discomfort to haematemesis, melaena, syncope, haemorrhagic shock, or sudden cardiovascular collapse. In some cases, fatal haemorrhage may occur before a definitive diagnosis is established or therapeutic intervention can be initiated, making sudden death the first clinical manifestation. In the emergency setting, upper gastrointestinal endoscopy remains the diagnostic gold standard; however, its utility may be limited in rapidly deteriorating or out-of-hospital patients. This review summarises the current evidence on the pathophysiology of variceal rupture, emergency clinical presentation, diagnostic pitfalls, and factors associated with sudden death. It also highlights the importance of early recognition, prompt risk stratification, and timely intervention to reduce mortality, while emphasising the role of clinicopathological correlation in patients presenting with fatal or unexplained upper gastrointestinal haemorrhage.

title: Pengaruh Work-Life Balance Dan Manajemen Waktu Terhadap Produktivitas Mahasiswa Pekerja Generasi Z Dengan Motivasi Kerja Sebagai Variabel Intervening (Studi Pada Mahasiswa STIE Widyaswara Indonesia)
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji dampak Work-Life Balance dan manajemen waktu terhadap produktivitas mahasiswa pekerja dari Generasi Z, serta menganalisis peran Intervening motivasi kerja pada mahasiswa di STIE Widyaswara Indonesia. Pendekatan penelitian kuantitatif asosiatif digunakan dalam studi ini. Populasi penelitian terdiri dari 87 mahasiswa pekerja Generasi Z. Teknik purposive sampling diterapkan dengan memilih mahasiswa aktif dari Generasi Z yang sedang bekerja dan bersedia berpartisipasi. Sebanyak 37 responden memenuhi kriteria dan memberikan jawaban lengkap pada kuesioner yang disebarkan. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan metode Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) dengan perangkat lunak SmartPLS. Hasil riset menunjukkan bahwa Work-Life Balance berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap motivasi kerja, sedangkan dampak langsung Work-Life Balance terhadap produktivitas tidak signifikan. Manajemen waktu memberikan dampak positif dan signifikan terhadap motivasi kerja, namun tidak memiliki pengaruh signifikan secara langsung terhadap produktivitas. Selanjutnya, motivasi kerja memberikan dampak positif dan signifikan terhadap produktivitas. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa motivasi kerja berperan penting dalam mendorong produktivitas mahasiswa pekerja Generasi Z, sedangkan Work-Life Balance dan manajemen waktu lebih tersambung dengan produktivitas melalui faktor motivasi kerja. This study aims to examine the impact of work-life balance and time management on the productivity of Generation Z working students, as well as to analyze the mediating role of work motivation among students at STIE Widyaswara Indonesia. An associative quantitative research approach was employed. The study population consisted of 87 Generation Z working students. A purposive sampling technique was applied, selecting active Generation Z students who were currently employed and willing to participate. A total of 37 respondents met the criteria and provided complete responses to the distributed questionnaires. Data analysis was conducted using the Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) method with SmartPLS software. The research results indicate that work-life balance has a positive and significant effect on work motivation, whereas its direct impact on productivity is not significant. Time management has a positive and significant impact on work motivation but does not exert a significant direct influence on productivity. Furthermore, work motivation has a positive and significant impact on productivity. The study demonstrates that work motivation plays a crucial role in driving the productivity of Generation Z working students, while work-life balance and time management are linked to productivity primarily through the factor of work motivation.

title: Pengaruh Pembelajaran Pendidikan Jasmani Adaptif Lempar Tangkap Bola Untuk Melatih Motorik Kasar Pada Anak Cerebral Palsy Kelas III Di SLBN Patrang Jember
abstractText: Latar belakang dalam penelitian ini berakar dari hambatan perkembangan motorik kasar yang dialami oleh anak berkebutuhan khusus dengan kondisi cerebral palsy, khususnya terkait keterbatasan stabilitas tubuh, ketangkasan koordinasi visual-motorik, serta kemampuan manipulatif seperti melempar dan menangkap. Berdasarkan fenomena tersebut, studi ini dirancang guna mengevaluasi sejauh mana intervensi pembelajaran Pendidikan Jasmani Adaptif yang memanfaatkan stimulasi permainan melempar dan menangkap bola mampu merangsang pertumbuhan motorik kasar peserta didik cerebral palsy kelas III di SLBN Patrang Jember. Pendekatan ekperimental kuantitatif diterapkan melalui skema One Group Pretest-Posttest Design. Penarikan sampel menggunakan teknik sasaran khusus yang melibatkan 5 siswa cerebral palsy tingkat Sekolah Luar Biasa kelas III. Rangkaian instrumen penilaian mencakup teknik pengamatan langsung, asesmen praktik unjuk kerja, serta dokumen pendukung. Parameter keberhasilan diukur melalui empat variabel utama, yakni aspek keseimbangan postural, koordinasi mata dan tangan, penguasaan mekanik melempar, serta kecakapan menangkap bola. Pengolahan data numerik diproses dengan pendekatan statistik nonparametrik memanfaatkan pengujian data Sign Test. This study was motivated by the gross motor difficulties commonly experienced by children with special needs diagnosed with cerebral palsy. These difficulties may be observed in maintaining body stability, coordinating visual information with motor responses, and performing manipulative movements, particularly throwing and catching. In response to these conditions, the present study sought to examine the effectiveness of an Adapted Physical Education program incorporating ball-throwing and catching activities in supporting the gross motor development of third-grade students with cerebral palsy at SLBN Patrang Jember.A quantitative experimental approach was employed using a One-Group Pretest-Posttest Design. The participants were five third-grade students with cerebral palsy at a special education school, selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected through direct observation, performance-based assessments, and supporting documentation. The students' gross motor abilities were evaluated across four primary indicators: postural balance, hand-eye coordination, throwing technique, and ball-catching skills. The resulting numerical data were subsequently examined using a nonparametric statistical procedure, namely the Sign Test.

title: GPR84-PET imaging visualizes tumor-associated myeloid cells in brain metastases
Analisis Kompetensi Karyawan Dan Pembagian Tugas Dalam Mendukung Kinerja Operasional Pada Hotway’s Chicken Plaju
abstractText: Penelitian ini dilakukan dengan tujuan untuk menganalisis peran kompetensi karyawan dan pembagian tugas dalam mendukung kinerja operasional pada Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. Penelitian ini menerapkan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui wawancara, observasi, dan dokumentasi dengan melibatkan informan yang terdiri atas pimpinan, karyawan, dan pelanggan Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kompetensi karyawan dan pembagian tugas memiliki peran dalam menunjang kinerja operasional pada Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. Pengetahuan, keterampilan, serta kemampuan karyawan dalam melaksanakan pekerjaan, didukung dengan pembagian tugas yang sesuai, membantu kelancaran kegiatan operasional melalui penerapan Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP) dan kerja sama antara anggota tim. This study aims to analyze the roles of employee competence and task allocation in supporting the operational performance of Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. A qualitative method with a descriptive approach was employed. Data were collected through interviews, observations, and documentation, involving informants comprising management, employees, and customers of Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. The results indicate that employee competence and task allocation play a role in supporting operational performance at Hotway’s Chicken Plaju. Employee knowledge, skills, and capabilities in performing their duties—supported by appropriate task allocation—facilitate smooth operational activities through the implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and teamwork among staff members.

title: Ultrasound imaging in extramammary Paget disease: Current applications and future perspectives
abstractText: Extramammary Paget disease is a rare cutaneous adenocarcinoma that predominantly arises in apocrine gland-rich anatomical regions. Its nonspecific indolent clinical presentation frequently results in diagnostic delay, allowing some lesions to progress to dermal invasion, regional lymph node involvement, or distant metastasis before definitive diagnosis. Ultrasonography provides complementary information on superficial lesion morphology, tumor invasion depth, regional lymph node status, and microvascular perfusion. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence regarding the applications of ultrasonography in extramammary Paget disease, with emphasis on conventional ultrasound (US), high-frequency US, and contrast-enhanced US for morphological characterization, assessment of local invasion, evaluation of regional lymph nodes, estimation of tumor invasion depth, and monitoring of treatment response. The strengths and limitations of these modalities are critically considered, including the limited evidence base, operator dependence, and lack of standardized imaging and measurement protocols. Multimodal US may offer a more comprehensive framework by integrating structural and functional information. Nevertheless, larger prospective studies, multicenter validation, and standardized imaging criteria are required before US-derived parameters can be reliably incorporated into routine clinical decision-making.

title: Local diagnostic reference levels and optimisation priorities for paediatric oncology computed tomography at Gaza’s sole specialist paediatric hospital
abstractText: BACKGROUND Published evidence on paediatric computed tomography (CT) dose indicators and diagnostic reference levels in Palestine is limited, particularly for children with cancer who may undergo repeated imaging. Local diagnostic reference levels provide practical optimisation benchmarks where national paediatric reference levels are unavailable. We therefore examined whether examination-specific and size-specific dose distributions could identify actionable local optimisation priorities. AIM To establish paediatric oncology CT local diagnostic reference levels and identify actionable dose-optimisation priorities at Gaza’s sole specialist paediatric referral hospital. METHODS This retrospective cross-sectional examination-level dose survey analysed 193 paediatric oncology CT examinations performed between March 2019 and December 2019. Age-specific and protocol-specific P75 values of scanner-recorded CTDIvol and dose-length product (DLP) were proposed as local dose audit benchmarks; P50 values and non-parametric bootstrap 95%CIs were also calculated. P75 estimates from groups of 4-9 examinations were treated as provisional. Additional descriptive analyses assessed patient-size grouping, scan range and protocol variability. Model-derived size-specific dose estimates, effective-dose and organ-dose estimates were not included because their computational inputs and conversion factors could not be recovered. RESULTS The principal CTDIvol P75 values were 23.46-23.73 mGy for brain CT, 2.44-3.15 mGy for chest CT, 4.68-6.78 mGy for abdomen CT and 4.66-7.50 mGy for chest/abdomen/pelvis CT in children aged 0-10 years. Provisional values for older small subgroups are reported separately. Chest/abdomen/pelvis CT demonstrated substantial DLP variability and extensive anatomical coverage, although brain CT had higher DLP in the two younger age groups. Confidence intervals were wider in smaller groups; an examination-level audit identified some discordance between recorded scan length and DLP/CTDIvol-derived length. Secondary associations were descriptive rather than evidence of avoidable dose. CONCLUSION These scanner-specific CT dose benchmarks provide a basis for local dose audit. Review of patient-size adaptation and scan range should be informed by clinical indication and image quality. Small-subgroup estimates remain provisional and patient-level dependence could not be quantified.

title: WHEN CORRECT CODE IS NOT ENOUGH: ASSESSING THE PRODUCTION READINESS OF LLMGENERATED SOFTWARE
abstractText: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate executable software, but functional correctness alone does not establish production readiness. This study evaluates GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna across 15 algorithmic and production-oriented tasks using five generations per model-task pair, yielding 225 generated programs plus 15 fixed references. The layered testbed combines nominal and hidden-edge-case checks, moderate and severe production-like stress, metamorphic validation, reference-normalized runtime and memory, structural quality, static analysis, implementation-strategy inspection, and generation cost. All 800 functional and 368 applicable robustness checks passed, while production-stress success fell to 95.16% for Sol, 95.60% for Terra, and 93.38% for Luna. Cross-model stress differences were not significant, but generation cost differed strongly. A Quick Sort case showed more than a 500x runtime spread among behaviorally correct implementations. The results show that production-oriented evaluation must extend beyond pass/fail correctness to include stress behavior, resources, implementation strategy, and cost

title: Learning-Based Grey Wolf Optimizer for Resource Optimization Design in Cloud-Edge Collaborative Environments
abstractText: Cloud-edge collaborative computing integrates the powerful computing capacity of cloud centers with the low-latency response of edge nodes, posing substantial challenges to resource scheduling under highly dynamic task loads. Balancing system operating costs and processing capacity constitutes a critical issue that urgently needs to be addressed. To tackle this problem, this paper models the cloud-edge collaborative system as a multi-server queuing system. It establishes a Cost-Performance Ratio (CPR) objective that jointly considers system capacity, operating costs and delay penalties. To address the rigid, linearly decreasing convergence factor of the standard Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), a Q-learning-based Grey Wolf Optimizer (QGWO) is proposed that integrates an adaptive convergence factor, hierarchical weights, stagnation-duration jumping, periodic replacement of inferior wolves, and a greedy-strategy-based position acceptance mechanism. To evaluate online reconfiguration capability, a dynamic step-changing task-arrival-rate schedule is used. Extensive simulations show that our proposed QGWO achieves a cumulative normalized regret 27% lower than that of the standard GWO, providing an effective scheme for on-demand dynamic resource scheduling in cloud-edge environments.

title: An Efficient Approximate Multiplier for Error-Resilient Neural Network and Image Processing Applications
abstractText: Approximate computing has emerged as a viable paradigm to balance accuracy and hardware efficiency, as the demand for edge computing increases. While multipliers are inherently power-intensive components, their approximation can lead to significant power savings. Although approximate compressors are effective for unsigned arithmetic, they often result in substantial accuracy degradation in signed multipliers. To mitigate this issue, a multiplier was developed to optimally utilize approximate compressors. Additionally, two novel approximate 4–2 compressors are introduced. The error metrics of the proposed multiplier were compared with state-of-the-art designs, and all hardware designs were synthesized and implemented using Cadence Innovus with a 90 nm ASIC technology node. The hybrid utilization of the two proposed compressors in the designed multiplier achieved reductions of 39.26% in area, 49% in power, 18.63% in delay and 74.8% in the Power-Delay Area Product (PDAP) compared to the exact Baugh–Wooley multiplier. The efficacy of the proposed multiplier was validated using neural network inference and Sobel edge detection. The results indicated that the proposed multiplier maintains the baseline accuracy, with only a 0.06% deviation in classification accuracy for Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and a 0.14% deviation for ResNet-50, and no discernible deterioration in edge-detection quality.

title: ലിംഗപദവി: സൈദ്ധാന്തിക സമീപനങ്ങൾ
abstractText: ജീവശാസ്ത്രപരമായ വ്യത്യാസങ്ങളെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ലൈംഗികതയിൽ നിന്ന് വ്യത്യസ്തമായി, ലിംഗപദവി എന്നത് പൂർണ്ണമായും പിതൃമേധാവിത്വ സമൂഹം സൃഷ്ടിച്ചെടുത്ത സാമൂഹ്യനിർമ്മിതിയാണെന്നത് ഫെമിനിസ്റ്റ് ചിന്തയുടെ അടിസ്ഥാനബോധ്യങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാണ്. പുരുഷന് സമൂഹത്തിൽ മേൽക്കോയ്മ നൽകാനും സ്ത്രീകളെ അധികാരശ്രേണിയിൽ താഴെ നിർത്താനും ഈ സങ്കല്പം കാരണമായിട്ടുണ്ട്. ലിംഗപദവി എന്നത് മനുഷ്യന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനപരമായ തെരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പല്ല, മറിച്ച് ഭാഷയിലൂടെയും സംസ്കാരത്തിലൂടെയും അധികാര ഘടനകളിലൂടെയും നിരന്തരം അടിച്ചേൽപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ഒന്നാണിത്. യഥാർത്ഥ വിമോചനം സാധ്യമാകണമെങ്കിൽ സമൂഹത്തിൽ ആഴത്തിൽ വേരൂന്നിയ ഈ പുരുഷാധിപത്യ വാർപ്പുമാതൃകകളെ പൂർണ്ണമായി പൊളിച്ചെഴുതുകയും സ്വന്തം ശരീരത്തിന്മേലും അസ്തിത്വത്തിന്മേലുമുള്ള അവകാശം തിരിച്ചുപിടിക്കുകയും വേണം . ലിംഗപദവിയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആധുനികമായ ചിന്തകളുടെ കേന്ദ്ര ആശയത്തെ പരിചയപെടുത്തുകയാണ് ഈ പഠനത്തിന്റെ ലക്‌ഷ്യം .

title: Rendahnya Pemanfaatan Perpustakaan Sekolah dan Implikasinya terhadap Karakter serta Kesadaran Sosial Siswa
abstractText: Perpustakaan sekolah merupakan fasilitas pendidikan yang berperan dalam mendukung pengembangan literasi, pembentukan karakter, dan kesadaran sosial siswa. Namun, keberadaan perpustakaan belum selalu diikuti oleh pemanfaatan yang optimal dalam kegiatan belajar. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan kebiasaan pemanfaatan perpustakaan sekolah, mengidentifikasi hambatan yang berkaitan dengan rendahnya pemanfaatan, serta menganalisis implikasinya terhadap pembentukan karakter dan kesadaran sosial siswa. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan metode library research atau penelitian kepustakaan. Data dikumpulkan melalui dokumentasi dengan menelusuri dan menyeleksi berbagai sumber pustaka yang relevan, meliputi buku, artikel jurnal ilmiah, dan hasil penelitian terdahulu. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan analisis isi secara deskriptif melalui pengelompokan tema, interpretasi, dan sintesis literatur. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa pemanfaatan perpustakaan sekolah dipengaruhi oleh kebiasaan membaca siswa, ketersediaan koleksi, kualitas fasilitas dan layanan, strategi pembelajaran, serta dukungan lingkungan sekolah dan keluarga. Perpustakaan berpotensi mendukung pembiasaan nilai tanggung jawab, kedisiplinan, kemandirian, empati, toleransi, dan kepedulian sosial melalui kegiatan membaca, diskusi, serta refleksi. Optimalisasi perpustakaan perlu diintegrasikan dengan budaya literasi sekolah dan kolaborasi berbagai pihak. Penelitian empiris lebih lanjut diperlukan untuk mengkaji keterkaitannya dengan perilaku nyata siswa.

title: Advances in imaging diagnosis of spinal cord injury: A review
abstractText: Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating central nervous system trauma characterized by high rates of disability, necessitating prompt and accurate diagnostic evaluation. Imaging diagnosis plays a critical role in the early assessment, injury grading, and prognosis prediction of SCI. This review systematically summarizes recent advances in imaging techniques used for SCI diagnosis, encompassing traditional modalities such as X-ray, computed tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as cutting-edge methods including diffusion tensor imaging, magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and functional MRI. The strengths and limitations of each technique in terms of injury localization, severity assessment, and prognostic value are thoroughly analyzed. Furthermore, the review explores emerging trends in multimodal imaging integration and the application of artificial intelligence to enhance diagnostic accuracy and clinical decision-making. By providing a comprehensive overview of current research and technological innovations, this article aims to support precision medicine approaches and improve clinical outcomes for patients with SCI.

title: Penerapan Ketentuan Pidana oleh Hakim Terhadap Terdakwa Tindak Pidana Perjudian Melalui Media Elektronik
abstractText: Perjudian merupakan penyakit masyarakat yang telah datang dan diancam pidana sesuai ketentuan Pasal 303 KUHP. Seiring perkembangan teknologi, jenis perjudian juga berkembang ke perjudian online yang diatur dalam Pasal 27 Ayat (2) Undang-undang Nomor 1 Tahun 2024 tentang Perubahan Kedua Atas Undang-undang Nomor 11 Tahun 2008 tentang Informasi dan Transaksi Elektronik. title: Integrating engineered image features with artificial intelligence to distinguish non-small cell lung cancer histological subtypes
abstractText: BACKGROUND Accurate differentiation of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) histological subtypes is crucial for effective treatment planning and improved prognosis. AIM To evaluate engineered pathological image features for exploratory classification of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC). METHODS Intensity, texture and component-shape features were extracted from tissue-containing patches at three image scales. The development cohort included 644 The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) patients and 200 Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC) patients; 100 additional CPTAC patients were held out for testing. Five-fold validation in the CPTAC development cohort, with TCGA patients included in each training partition, selected a logistic-regression model. Preprocessing, model fitting and threshold selection used development data only. We assessed accuracy, F1 score, recall and area under the curve (AUC), with conditional patient-bootstrap confidence intervals (CI). The decision to report the engineered model family followed a broader model comparison. RESULTS The adapted model achieved an AUC of 0.8984 (95%CI: 0.8340-0.9532) and an accuracy of 83.0% (95%CI: 76.0%-90.0%) on the 100-patient CPTAC holdout. Sensitivity was 84.0% for LUAD and 82.0% for LUSC. The original TCGA-trained support vector machine achieved an AUC of 0.5902 on the same patients; the paired AUC increase was 0.3082 (95%CI: 0.1770-0.4416). During development, mean fold AUC was 0.8220 ± 0.0271; this estimate was used for model selection. CONCLUSION Engineered image features showed potential for NSCLC histological subtyping in this exploratory analysis. Testing used separate CPTAC patients after adaptation to CPTAC data. Validation in an independent study and expert assessment of the tissue and component masks are needed before clinical use can be considered.

title: Enhancing SDLC Efficiency: A Case Study Comparing Low-Code and Traditional Development Approaches
abstractText: In software development environments, there is a constant and growing demand for fast and uncomplicated solutions. In this context, the adoption of alternative approaches becomes essential. This study presents a comparative case analysis between traditional software development models and those that utilize low-code platforms, specifically Scriptcase and Pentaho. Although low-code platforms have gained prominence in the industry, empirical studies that deeply analyze their real impact on productivity and efficiency in software development are still rare, especially in contexts involving the development of web systems dedicated to operational demands. This research aims to fill this gap by investigating whether low-code tools effectively contribute to efficiency gains in the development process. The adopted methodology includes structured observations and questionnaires, as well as quantitative and qualitative analysis of efficiency indicators such as development time, lines of code produced, and lead time. The comparison was conducted through the development of equivalent systems using both approaches, allowing an empirical evaluation of each stage of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). The results found indicated trade-offs among improved efficiency, speed, and flexibility, suggesting that the choice of a development strategy should consider the project scope, complexity, and team expertise based on the type of product that will be developed. This case study was conducted within a single organization and with two development teams; therefore, results should be interpreted as context-dependent evidence.

title: Combining Time Series and Recurrent Network Approaches for Long-Term Prediction of Emergency Department Admissions
abstractText: The high variability in admissions to emergency departments complicates the adjustment of resource allocation, resulting in rigid policies that lead to inefficient service. Other works have addressed this problem using statistical analysis, machine learning regressors, or time series data models. This research addresses the need for the planning of available resources by proposing the use of improved recurrent neural networks that consider the dynamic nature of data and experience by introducing contextual variables, thereby improving predictability. This approach allows for accurate short- and long-term forecasts, achieving an average absolute percentage error of around 6-7% for forecasts spanning seven days and four months.

title: A Gossip Learning-based Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning for Intrusion Detection
abstractText: Addressing the pressing security challenges in network environments, we present a novel Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL)-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS), leveraging insights from gossip algorithms and imitation learning. Our model capitalizes on the synergies between agents, incorporating adaptive strategies inspired by gossip protocols to enhance information sharing within the network. Furthermore, imitation learning mechanisms are integrated to empower agents with the capability to mimic successful detection behaviors. The collective intelligence harnessed through MARL enables the IDS to dynamically adapt to evolving threats in complex network environments. Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, we demonstrate the efficacy of our novel approach reaching 98% of accuracy across two benchmark datasets, showcasing its potential to address contemporary cybersecurity challenges.

title: LLAMA3-Powered Threat Hunting with MITRE ATT&CK in Real-Time
abstractText: In the rapidly evolving landscape of cybersecurity, the need for advanced and proactive threat detection mechanisms is paramount. This paper presents a novel framework that integrates Meta's LLAMA 3.1 8B Instruct Model with the MITRE ATT&CK framework to enhance the real-time detection of adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). By leveraging domain-adaptive fine-tuning on meticulously synthesized and curated datasets from MITRE ATT&CK framework, this research addresses critical gaps in current threat detection methodologies, particularly regarding real-time processing, domain specificity, and the adaptation to previously unseen or variant TTPs. It employs the LLAMA 3.1 model along with datasets derived from MITRE's Enterprise Matrix. A weighted scoring system evaluates the effectiveness of the newly generated TTPs based on four criteria: relevance, novelty, impact, and feasibility. Furthermore, the framework rigorously assesses its robustness to adversarial modifications by employing perturbation techniques to generate synthetic attack variations, and by utilizing the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) Trainer alongside QLoRA to achieve parameter efficiency, custom reward functions, and penalty mechanisms. This integrated approach equips cyber threat hunters with a powerful tool for identifying covert, emergent, and adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). This capability significantly enhances overall cybersecurity resilience.

title: A Model-Driven Approach for Design and Generation of Collaborative Cross-platform Graphical Editors in Engineering Education
abstractText: This work introduces a Model-Driven Development (MDD) approach for the design and automatic generation of collaborative cross-platform and multitouch graphical editors tailored to engineering education. The proposed method facilitates the creation of customizable graphical editors, aiming to balance ease of use with the flexibility afforded by model-based design. While a foundational understanding of modelling tools is advantageous during the initial development phase, the resulting editors provides an inclusive user experience across diverse devices and operating environments. A preliminary evaluation involving university professors has been conducted to assess the effectiveness of the approach. The results underscore several strengths, notably the high degree of automation and the support for collaborative learning scenarios. Nonetheless, the evaluation also revealed limitations, including usability issues and dependence on specific integrated development environments (e.g., Eclipse). Overall, the proposed approach contributes to the advancement of scalable and innovative modelling tools in engineering education, fostering active learning and enhanced conceptual comprehension of modelling languages.

title: Pedagogical Design and Learning Outcomes in Online and Blended Library and Information Science Education
abstractText: Online and blended courses can widen opportunities for participation in library and information science education, but delivery mode alone does not explain what students learn. This narrative review examines how course design connects flexible access with the development and assessment of professional capabilities. It brings literature on blended learning, constructive alignment and self-regulation into dialogue with selected recent studies of responsible AI use, teacher learning and personalization. The analysis distinguishes participation, perceived confidence and demonstrated competence, while treating evidence from other disciplines as contextual. A proposed instructional cycle links preparation, guided practice, feedback and independent application. Illustrative designs address metadata creation, reference consultation, digital collection curation and information literacy instruction. The review specifies how each activity can generate evidence of learning and how optional AI assistance should be bounded and disclosed. Effective implementation requires accessible materials, realistic workload and support for teachers and students. The article provides design propositions and evaluation priorities rather than original intervention findings or an estimate of comparative effectiveness. It argues for assessing the tasks students can complete and justify, with attention to whether learning transfers beyond the assisted course activity.

title: Comparative analysis of three classification systems for Mullerian anomalies using magnetic resonance imaging
abstractText: BACKGROUND Mullerian duct anomalies (MDA) have a major impact on women’s reproductive health causing infertility and recurrent miscarriage. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)’s multi-planar imaging capabilities allow non-invasive delineation of uterine anatomic characteristics and zonal anatomy facilitating accurate diagnosis. Multiple classification systems create non-uniform reporting templates. Few previous studies have tried to compare these classification systems. Proposed null hypothesis: All classification systems have equal classification completeness. AIM To compare the classification completeness of American Fertility Society (AFS), European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology/European Society for Gynaecological Endoscopy (ESHRE/ESGE) and American Society for Reproductive Medicine (ASRM) classification systems for MDA identified on MRI. METHODS Retrospective assessment of MRI pelvis of 53 patients diagnosed with MDA on a 1.5 T MRI was done. Attempt was made to categorize all the cases as per three classification systems and their classification completeness (ability to completely classify the anomaly) was calculated. Statistical significance of the differences in the classification completeness was assessed using Cochran’s Q test. Pairwise comparison was performed using McNemar test. Association of endometrioma with obstructive MDA was assessed by Fisher exact test. RESULTS The mean age of patients was 22.8 ± 9.5 years. Three most common anomalies were Mullerian agenesis (32.1%), septate uterus (18.9%) and hypoplastic uterus (17%). The difference in the classification completeness of AFS (67.9%), ESHRE/ESGE (98.1%) and ASRM (75.5%) is statistically significant (P < 0.001, Cochran’s Q = 21.895, n = 53) thus rejecting the null hypothesis. Endometrioma showed significant association with obstructive MDA (odds ratio = 6.61; 95%CI: 1.41-30.92; Fisher’s exact test, P = 0.020). CONCLUSION The ESHRE/ESGE classification demonstrated the highest classification completeness for MRI-identified MDA, compared with lower rates for the AFS and ASRM systems. This suggests broader classification coverage, particularly for complex and combined anomalies but does not establish superior diagnostic accuracy, reproducibility, or clinical utility. Further multicenter studies incorporating interobserver agreement and clinically relevant outcomes are warranted to determine the comparative performance and practical applicability of these classification systems.

Mindful coaches and calmer athletes: A quasi-experimental study of a mindfulness-acceptance-commitment-based, need-supportive coaching program and longitudinal changes in youth sport anxiety
abstractText: Objectives: Competitive youth sport can heighten anxiety, while coaches shape the interpersonal and motivational climate in which athletes experience performance demands. This study examined whether a Mindfulness-Acceptance-Commitment (MAC) coach-training program integrated with Self-Determination Theory (SDT) was associated with longitudinal changes in youth athletes’ sport anxiety and perceptions of attentive and need-supportive coaching. Methods: Youth athletes (N = 106; 55 intervention, 51 control), nested within 10 coaches, completed measures at pre-intervention, post-intervention, and 6-week follow-up. Linear mixed-effects models assessed Time × Group effects. Prospective regression and multilevel within- and between-person models examined longitudinal associations between perceived need-supportive coaching and anxiety. Results: Significant Time × Group interactions were observed for sport anxiety, F(2, 204.17) = 3.88, p = .022; perceived attentive coaching, F(2, 204.83) = 8.55, p < .001; and perceived need-supportive coaching, F(2, 203.12) = 6.45, p = .002. Higher post-intervention perceived need-supportive coaching predicted lower follow-up anxiety after covariate adjustment (b = −0.47, 95% CI [−0.71, 0.24], p < .001). Coach-clustered robust inference supported within-person (b = −0.21, p = .038) and between-person (b = −0.48, p = .007) associations with anxiety. Conclusions: MAC- and SDT-informed coach development may support favorable coaching climates and anxiety trajectories in youth sport. Greater perceived need-supportive coaching was longitudinally associated with lower anxiety, although these findings do not establish mediation or causality.

title: Exploring the Impact of Green Energy and Economic Growth on Environmental Quality in Asia: A Panel ARDL Approach
abstractText: This paper examines the impact of green energy and economic growth on environmental quality in 16 Asian countries using a panel autoregressive distributed lag model for the period 2000–2020. The findings indicate that green energy consumption positively affects environmental quality, whereas economic growth has a negative effect. Therefore, policies aimed at increasing renewable energy production and consumption should be implemented to improve environmental quality.

title: Women in Leadership Roles
abstractText: The evolution of women in the workplace shows a journey from domestic confinement to significant labor force participation, driven by education, economic needs, and social change, moving women into diverse roles from factories to boardrooms. The new trend of hiring women for leadership roles has created a "virtuous cycle" where increased representation makes an organization more likely to hire additional female leaders in the future. Recent meta-analytic data suggest that women are often rated as more effective leaders than men in organizational settings, particularly in business and educational contexts. Despite the challenges of ‘glass cliffs’, stereotypes, and ‘mother penalties’, women continue to excel in leadership roles across industries, which has the potential to surpass discriminatory biases that currently hinder capable females from leading in more global organizations.

title: Resilience as a partial mediator of digital-tool satisfaction, organisational support and employee engagement in South African higher education
abstractText: Background: Digital transformation has reshaped university work, but access to technology does not necessarily produce an enabling digital work experience. In historically disadvantaged settings, employees navigate digital inequality, changing work practices and uneven institutional support. Resilience may help employees mobilise resources and remain engaged. Objectives: This study examined whether resilience partially accounts for the relationships of digital-tool satisfaction and perceived organisational support with employee engagement among staff at a South African higher education institution. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was completed by 282 academic and professional or administrative employees at a historically disadvantaged public university. Multi-item measures assessed engagement, organisational support, resilience and digital-tool satisfaction. Descriptive, correlational, regression and bootstrap indirect-effect analyses were conducted. Results: Digital-tool satisfaction, organisational support and resilience were positively associated with engagement and each made an independent contribution. Resilience partially accounted for the relationships of both contextual resources with engagement. Conclusion: Employees were more engaged when they experienced satisfactory digital tools, perceived institutional support and reported greater resilience. The findings are consistent with resilience as one adaptive pathway linking contextual resources to engagement, but the cross-sectional design does not establish temporal or causal mediation. Contribution: The study offers a contextually grounded career-resource account of engagement in a digitally transforming African university. It highlights the joint importance of institutional investment and employee adaptive capacity, while cautioning against treating resilience as a substitute for equitable infrastructure and support.

title: Rekonstruksi Pembuktian terhadap Keabsahan Dokumen dan Tanda Tangan Elektronik dalam Era Kecerdasan Artifisial: Perspektif Hukum Acara Perdata Indonesia
abstractText: The advancement of digital technology and generative artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly transformed the creation of electronic documents and signatures. Although the Electronic Information and Transactions (EIT) Law and its implementing regulations have legally recognized electronic documents and signatures as valid evidence, the conventional civil procedural evidence system faces severe challenges. These challenges stem from the rise of document falsification, the threat of deepfakes, and the risk of exploiting AI-manipulation claims to evade legal liability (the liar's dividend). This normative legal research examines the gap between the norms of electronic evidence recognition and authentication needs in the AI era, utilizing statute, conceptual, and comparative approaches (comparing with UNCITRAL and the European Union framework). The findings indicate that current legal recognition is limited to admissibility, failing to adequately address evidential weight and digital forensic verification standards. Therefore, an ideal legal reconstruction is required through the implementation of an electronic signature trust hierarchy, proportional burden of proof allocation, digital forensic standards, and the harmonization of synthetic content regulations to ensure legal certainty and justice in civil litigation.

title: Analisis Perbandingan Kualitas Aplikasi dan Layanan Sepeda Motor (Bike) Transportasi Online (Gojek, Grab, dan Maxim) di Samarinda Menggunakan Metode Histogram dan Spider Web
abstractText: This study aims to analyze and compare application quality and motorcycle (bike) service quality across Gojek, Grab, and Maxim in Samarinda. A descriptive comparative quantitative approach was applied to 108 active undergraduate respondents from the Faculty of Economics and Business, Mulawarman University, selected via purposive sampling (36 respondents per platform). Data were collected through a 1–5 Likert scale questionnaire covering six indicators grouped into application quality (P1–P3) and motorcycle service quality (P4–P6), then analyzed using mean scores, histograms, and Spider Web charts based on awarding 1 point for the highest indicator score. Results show Grab leads in application quality (3 points), achieving the highest score in interface ease and information clarity (P2 = 4.58), leading in error-free booking (P1 = 4.28), and matching Gojek in response speed (P3 = 4.14). In motorcycle service, Gojek leads (2 points) in pickup speed (P4 = 4.19) and riding comfort (P5 = 4.22) but scores lowest in fare fairness (P6 = 3.50), whereas Maxim earns 1 point for fare fairness (P6 = 4.44) but lags on other indicators. Findings highlight the need to balance application reliability, driver service, and fares.

title: Kegiatan Kolektif Dalam Membentuk Solidaritas Organik di Asrama Mahasiwa Kabupaten Kapuas Hulu di Kota Pontianak
abstractText: The purpose of this study is to understand collective activities in forming organic solidarity at the Student Dormitory of Kapuas Hulu Regency in Pontianak City. The method used is a descriptive qualitative method. The data collection techniques used are observation, interviews, and documentation. The data analysis techniques used are data reduction, data presentation, and drawing conclusions. The analysis in this study involved seven informants. The results of the study show that (1) physical collective activities in forming organic solidarity include communal work and mutual cooperation. (2) intellectual collective activities in forming organic solidarity include group discussions and article reviews. (3) Spiritual collective activities in forming organic solidarity are group prayers. This research can provide information and benefits for dormitory students, can serve as a guideline as a reference material, and can be used as evaluation material for the effectiveness of activities related to forming organic solidarity

abstractText: The sexual abuse of minors is a legal issue that threatens the safety and development of children. This study aims to examine the legal framework and enforcement regarding the sexual abuse of children, as well as the challenges encountered in handling such cases within the jurisdiction of the Seruyan Police (Polres Seruyan) in Seruyan Regency, Central Kalimantan Province. The research was conducted by analyzing legislation concerning child protection in relation to data on cases of the sexual abuse of minors obtained from the Seruyan Police. The findings indicate that addressing cases of child sexual abuse involves not only the application of the law but also the protection of the victim's identity and mental well-being. Support from the victim's family and the surrounding community is also essential throughout the handling process. Data from the Seruyan Police reveal an upward trend in cases of child sexual abuse: 2 cases in 2023, 4 cases in 2024, and 5 cases in 2025. These figures demonstrate that the sexual abuse of children remains a critical issue requiring special attention, necessitating a law enforcement approach that prioritizes the protection of children's rights.

Model Artificial Neural Network (NARX) untuk Prediksi Harga Emas sebagai Dasar Pengambilan Keputusan Investasi di Tengah Ketidakpastian Ekonomi
abstractText: Gold prices are an investment instrument influenced by various macroeconomic factors; consequently, their market efficiency is dynamic and not always perfect. The US dollar exchange rate and interest rates are key factors affecting gold prices in the global market. This study develops a prediction model for gold closing prices using an Artificial Neural Network with a Nonlinear Autoregressive Exogenous (NARX) architecture. The model incorporates gold’s opening, high, and low prices, the USD/IDR exchange rate, and Bank Indonesia’s benchmark interest rate as exogenous variables. The dataset consists of daily time-series data from January 2, 2023, to July 1, 2026, comprising 802 observations. We determined model parameters through a trial-and-error approach, varying the number of delays, the number of neurons in the hidden layer, and three training algorithms: Levenberg-Marquardt, Bayesian Regularization, and Scaled Conjugate Gradient. The results indicate that the optimal configuration is achieved with 4 delays, the Bayesian Regularization algorithm, and 10 neurons, yielding a Mean Squared Error of 235,031,460.78. Accuracy evaluation using the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) resulted in 0.671 percent, classified as "highly accurate", with a coefficient of determination of 0.9993. These findings show that the NARX model can predict gold closing prices with a very high degree of accuracy, making it a useful tool for investors making investment decisions amid economic uncertainty.

A class of cubic decompositions of polynomial sequences associated with a q -analogue of the Dunkl operator
abstractText: In this paper, we study a class of lowering operators which are constructed as finite products of lowering operators in terms of the q -analogue of the Dunkl operator. Our first goal is to characterize polynomial sequences that satisfy an Appell-type relation with respect to such operators. Secondly, by analyzing a cubic decomposition of a q -Dunkl–Appell sequence, we demonstrate that the sequences formed by its polynomial components also exhibit Appell-type properties, expressed in terms of a product of three operators associated with the q -analogue of the Dunkl operator.

abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menguji pengaruh rasio aktivitas yang diproksikan dengan Total Asset Turnover (TATO) dan rasio pasar yang diproksikan dengan Earning Per Share (EPS) terhadap harga saham PT Paramita Bangun Sarana Tbk (PBSA). Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode asosiatif. Data yang digunakan merupakan data sekunder tahunan selama periode 2016–2025, dengan jumlah 10 pengamatan, yang bersumber dari laporan tahunan perusahaan dan Yahoo Finance. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan SPSS versi 20. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa secara parsial TATO tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap harga saham, dengan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,688. EPS juga tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap harga saham, dengan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,119. Secara simultan, TATO dan EPS tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap harga saham, dengan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,141. Nilai R Square sebesar 0,429 dan Adjusted R Square sebesar 0,266 menunjukkan bahwa model penelitian mampu menjelaskan 42,9% variasi harga saham (26,6% setelah disesuaikan), sedangkan sisanya dijelaskan oleh faktor lain di luar model. abstractText: Natural fibers and polymers are attracting increasing attention in engineering and industrial applications due to the growing demand for sustainable, environmentally friendly materials. Therefore, the novelty of this work lies in the comprehensive investigation of flax fiber-reinforced thermoplastic polypropylene (flax/PP) composites with varying thicknesses and stacking sequences, and in comparing them with flax fiber-reinforced thermoset epoxy (flax/epoxy) composites, to optimize the balance among strength, stiffness, and toughness while preserving the environmental advantages of natural fiber composites. Tensile, flexural, and impact tests were conducted to investigate the mechanical behavior of the fabricated composites. The experimental results revealed that the composite with 79.5 wt.% flax fiber in the PP matrix exhibited the highest tensile strength, 40.07 MPa, among the conditions investigated. The findings demonstrate that optimizing the flax fiber content significantly improves the balance between strength, stiffness, and toughness. In addition, the thermoplastic flax/PP composites exhibited enhanced sustainability and recyclability, whereas the thermoset flax/epoxy composites provided comparatively higher structural rigidity. Furthermore, the developed flax/PP composites offer notable environmental benefits while achieving mechanical properties comparable to those of conventional synthetic composites. Therefore, this work contributes to the advancement of lightweight, sustainable composite materials suitable for applications in construction, automotive, and aerospace industries.

abstractText: Background R2R3-MYB transcription factors are involved in diverse biological processes in plants, but their pan-genome characteristics and possible roles in pear fruit ripening remain unclear. Here, we performed a pan-genome analysis of the R2R3-MYB family across eight pear genomes and further examined candidate genes potentially associated with ripening. Results A total of 1,549 R2R3-MYB genes were identified and grouped into 127 orthologous gene groups (OGGs), including core, softcore, dispensable, and private groups. Pan-genome analysis indicated that the pear R2R3-MYB family is largely conserved. Duplication analysis suggested that whole-genome duplication and dispersed duplication contributed most to family expansion, and most duplicated gene pairs showed Ka/Ks values below 1, indicating predominant purifying selection. Phylogenetic analysis identified an S20 clade related to the Arabidopsis AtMYB108 lineage. By integrating published transcriptome datasets, several ripening-associated R2R3-MYB candidate genes were identified, including four S20-associated genes (Pbr014994.1, Pbr038922.1, Pbr013315.1, and Pbr020295.1). Expression analysis showed that Pbr014994.1 was associated with fruit ripening in most pear cultivars examined. Further co-expression analysis revealed positive associations between Pbr014994.1 and the ethylene biosynthesis-related genes PbrACO1 and PbrACS1b, whereas its association with PbrACS3 was weaker. Pbr014994.1 was predominantly localized in the nucleus. Conclusions These results provide a pan-genome view of the pear R2R3-MYB family and identify ripening-associated candidate genes in pear. The expression and co-expression patterns further suggest that Pbr014994.1 is a promising candidate potentially associated with ethylene-related fruit ripening.
